title: Define shared test suite for LogStorage implementations
description:
Write a set of async test functions (not marked #[test] directly) that accept any impl LogStorage and exercise all trait methods: insert and retrieve, set and list tips, count, has_entry for missing ID. These functions are called from both the mem and SQLite implementation tests. Artifact: core/src/group_log/storage_tests.rs.

Acceptance: shared tests exercise all trait methods; both implementations pass all shared tests; tests are deterministic (no randomness)
